name: card
what: The finished box: a surface with border, radius, built-in padding and a gap between its children, plus an optional coloured status edge.
render: import { div, h3, p } from '/app.js'; div.c('card', () => { h3('Title'); p('A card needs no extra CSS.'); });
notes: Count is files whose class strings mention card, including hand-rolled ones. Reserves a 3px inline-start edge always, so it is 3px narrower inside than .surface.

name: surface
what: The bare box look (background, border, radius) with no padding; the base every component adds its own padding to.
render: import { div, p } from '/app.js'; div.c('surface pad', () => p('A surface plus a pad.'));
notes: 'surface pad' (132 files) does the same job as .card but pads with --pad, not --pad-card, and has no gap rhythm or edge: twin with different spacing.

name: wash
what: A quiet filled background, used for placeholders, media areas and count chips.
render: import { div } from '/app.js'; div.c('wash pad', 'A washed band');
notes: wash and tint are two background words for near-identical jobs.

name: tint
what: A tinted background token class, sibling of wash.
render: import { div } from '/app.js'; div.c('tint pad', 'A tinted band');
notes: Class was once missing while token existed and painted nothing silently.

name: pad
what: Padding word: gives any box the page-region padding.
render: import { div } from '/app.js'; div.c('surface pad', 'Padded');
notes: Not a box itself; listed because it is the spacing half of surface pad.

name: bleed
what: Layout word: a block on a five-track page that takes the full width, edge to edge, including the page inset.
bleeds: yes: spans all five grid tracks
notes: Rule lives in the theme layer (page-column-prose > .bleed); not standalone drawable, needs a standard page. Count includes other 'bleed' uses (e.g. ai css).

name: stat tile
what: A small surface with a muted label above a big number.
render: import { div } from '/app.js'; div.c('surface pad flex v gap', () => { div.c('h4 muted', 'Files'); div.c('h2', '472'); });
notes: Template only, no export. Same 'label + value' box is hand-built elsewhere.

name: content card (template)
what: A card built from surface pad: kicker, title, text; variants with a link, media header or action row.
render: import { div, h3, p } from '/app.js'; div.c('surface pad flex v gap', () => { div.c('h4 muted', 'Core'); h3('View'); p('A DOM element.'); });
bleeds: media variant: image inside surface without pad
notes: The ui/card page still teaches 'surface pad flex v gap', the older form the .card word replaced; the two disagree on gap (0.5*--gap vs --gap).

name: alert
what: A one-row notice with an icon and message, optional action button, tone by extra class.
render: import { div, p, icon } from '/app.js'; div.c('ui-alert surface pad flex gap accent', () => { icon('info'); p('Heads up').ac('flex-1'); });
notes: CSS-only template, copy-paste.

name: panel (dialog-look box)
what: A surface with a head row, padded body and optional foot; the static look of a modal.
render: import { div, h3, p } from '/app.js'; div.c('ui-panel surface', () => { div.c('ui-panel-head pad flex v-center split gap', () => h3('Title')); div.c('pad', () => p('Body')); });
padding: --pad per region (head, body, foot padded separately)
notes: Name clashes with ext/Panel (a different, layout-editing thing).

name: dialog
what: A native <dialog> element styled as a surface with padding.
render: import { div, el, button } from '/app.js'; div.c('surface pad', () => button('see /ui/dialog/ page'));
notes: Needs showModal() wiring; render simplified, use the page's own template.

name: badge / pill
what: A small rounded label for status or counts.
render: import { span } from '/app.js'; span.c('ui-badge ui-pill h4 accent', 'shipped');
notes: ui-badge ui-pill is also the tag chip and the filter chip: one visual under three names.

name: tag chip
what: A pill holding a tag name with a small × to remove it.
render: import { span } from '/app.js'; span.c('ui-pill h4 flex v-center gap', () => { span('core'); span.c('muted', '×'); });
notes: ux/Tags gives it real behavior.

name: filter chip
what: A badge pill with × that clears one active filter.
notes: Needs a Filter instance; not standalone.

name: avatar stack
what: Overlapping round initials for people, one accent, one wash '+4' overflow.
render: import { div, span } from '/app.js'; div.c('ui-avatars', () => { span.c('ui-avatar','ML'); span.c('ui-avatar accent','AK'); });

name: crumbs
what: A row of path segments separated by chevrons or slashes.
render: import { div, span, a } from '/app.js'; div.c('ui-crumbs flex wrap v-center h4 gap', () => { a('Home').href('/'); span('/'); span('Here'); });

name: decision card
what: A question with a list of options, one marked chosen, each with a reason.
render: import { div, li, p, span } from '/app.js'; div.c('ui-decision surface', () => { p.c('ui-decision-ask','Which?'); div.c('ui-decision-options', () => li.c('ui-decision-option chosen', () => { div.c('ui-decision-say','A'); p.c('ui-decision-why','because'); })); });
notes: Tier C should compare against the AI decision card.

name: menu (dropdown)
what: A <details> button that opens a small list of items.
notes: Three menus: ui-menu (css template), ux/Menu, and Popover.menu(); three spacings.

name: accordion item
what: A <details> row that shows a question and reveals an answer.
render: import { div, details, summary, p } from '/app.js'; div.c('surface flex v', () => details.c('ui-accordion-item pad', () => { summary('Question'); p('Answer'); }));

name: tooltip
what: A word that shows a small bubble on hover.
render: import { span } from '/app.js'; span.c('ui-tooltip', () => { span.c('ui-tooltip-word','hover'); span.c('ui-tooltip-bubble','Hello'); });
notes: CSS tooltip vs JS tooltip in ux/Popover.

name: table
what: A table from header names and row arrays; '.num' aligns numbers.
render: import { table } from '/app.js'; table(['Name','Lines'], [['View',472],['Router',146]]);

name: timeline
what: A vertical list of dated entries joined by a dot and line.
render: import { timeline } from '/app.js'; timeline(['2026-09','Shipped','Notes']);

name: keys
what: A row of keyboard key caps joined by +.
render: import { keys } from '/app.js'; keys('Ctrl','K');

name: toolbar
what: A padded surface bar holding groups of buttons.
render: import { div, button } from '/app.js'; div.c('surface pad flex wrap gap v-center', () => { button('One'); button('Two'); });

name: progress row
what: A label, optional value and a bar.
notes: Template only in page.js.

name: pagination
what: A row of page-number buttons with previous/next.
notes: ui/pagination is the template, ux/Pagination the class. Not opened in full.

name: form field
what: A label above an input or select.

name: popover
what: A floating box anchored to an element, used for tooltips and action menus.
notes: Needs an anchor element.

name: wizard
what: A step-by-step flow with a step rail, crumbs, body and Next/Back controls.
notes: Needs step definitions; see page.

name: course
what: A lesson viewer: a chapter rail card, the lesson, and a 'next up' side card.
notes: Uses surface pad twice, not .card.

name: auth form
what: Login, signup and reset forms as vertical flex forms with a prim submit.
notes: Needs an auth backend.

name: tree
what: An expandable list of nested items, with drag and keyboard support in ux/Tree.
notes: ui/tree tree() retired 2026-08-21; only its stylesheet remains.

name: dictate button
what: A microphone control that records and shows live transcription.
notes: Needs microphone access; not opened in full.
